scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build:cli
scripts.build:all-sites: npm run build:www && npm run build:json
scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @rediacc/shared && npm run build -w @rediacc/provisioning
scripts.check:ci-account-no-admin-role: ! grep -rn "enum.*customer.*admin\|enum.*admin.*customer" private/account/src/db/schema.ts private/account/src/types/user.ts 2>/dev/null && echo 'OK: no admin user role'
scripts.check:ci-account-scope-audit: cd private/account && npx vitest run tests/integration/scope-audit.test.ts --reporter=dot
scripts.check:ci-account-config-auth: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const c=fs.readFileSync('private/account/src/routes/configs.ts','utf8');const lines=c.split('\n');let ok=true;lines.forEach((l,i)=>{if(l.includes('configTokenAuth()')){const ctx=lines.slice(i,i+5).join(' ');if(!ctx.includes('requireOrgMembership()')){console.error('FAIL: configTokenAuth() without requireOrgMembership() near line '+(i+1));ok=false}}});if(!ok)process.exit(1);console.log('OK: all configTokenAuth() calls paired with requireOrgMembership()')"
scripts.check:i18n: tsx scripts/check-translation-hashes.ts && tsx scripts/check-translation-completeness.ts && tsx scripts/check-translation-key-usage.ts && tsx scripts/__tests__/check-translation-key-usage.control.ts && npm run check:ci-i18n-cli-key-usage && npm run check:ci-i18n-cli-help-render && tsx scripts/check-docs-inline-translations.ts && tsx scripts/check-docs-untranslated-text.ts && tsx scripts/check-account-email-templates.ts && npm run validate:cli-docs -w @rediacc/www && npm run validate:docs-cli-usage -w @rediacc/www && npm run validate:landing-cli-usage -w @rediacc/www && npm run validate:translation-freshness -w @rediacc/www && npm run validate:content -w @rediacc/www && npm run validate:content-accuracy -w @rediacc/www && npm run validate:comparison-refs -w @rediacc/www && tsx scripts/check-component-hardcoded-strings.ts --strict && npm run check:cli-docs && tsx scripts/check-i18n-naturalization.ts && npm run check:ci-i18n-locale-only
scripts.check:lint: NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=8192 eslint packages scripts private/account --max-warnings 0 && biome lint private/account/ --error-on-warnings
scripts.check:types: tsc -b packages/shared packages/provisioning packages/cli && tsc --noEmit -p private/account/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p scripts/tsconfig.json
scripts.clean: npm run clean -w @rediacc/shared && npm run clean -w @rediacc/cli
scripts.fix: npm run fix:format && npm run fix:lint
scripts.fix:all: npm run fix:format && npm run fix:lint && npm run fix:unused && npm run fix:i18n
scripts.fix:lint: NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=8192 eslint packages scripts private/account --fix && biome lint --fix private/account/
scripts.typecheck: tsc -b packages/shared packages/provisioning packages/cli && tsc --noEmit -p private/account/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p scripts/tsconfig.json

_overridesReasons.body-parser: BLOCKER: force 2.3.0 to clear GHSA-v422-hmwv-36x6 (DoS via an invalid limit value that silently disables body-size enforcement; vulnerable >=2.0.0 <2.3.0 and <1.20.6). express@5 pulls body-parser ^2.2.1 which froze the lockfile at 2.2.2; 2.3.0 is the patched 2.x line and satisfies express's range. Advisory published after 2.3.0 (2026-06-15) had already aged past minimum-release-age, so this is a straight patched-version bump, not a deferral.
_overridesReasons.glob: BLOCKER: force glob ^11 everywhere to avoid the deprecated transitive glob <9 chain pulled in via older eslint tooling paths
_overridesReasons.rimraf: BLOCKER: force rimraf ^6 to avoid unmaintained v2/v3 transitive chains still referenced by older build/lint tooling
_overridesReasons.rollup: BLOCKER: pin rollup ^4.59 to ensure all workspaces resolve the same native binary set and avoid platform-specific optional-dep drift
_overridesReasons.fast-xml-parser: BLOCKER: pin 5.10.1 (raised from 5.8.0 for @astrojs/rss 4.0.19) to carry the CDATA/comment injection fix (GHSA-gh4j-gqv2-49f6) plus the entity-expansion limit family; without the pin transitive consumers drift below the fixed range
_overridesReasons.flatted: BLOCKER: force >=3.4.2 to pick up prototype pollution fix landed after vitest/@vitest transitive pin held older versions
_overridesReasons.smol-toml: BLOCKER: force >=1.6.1 to pick up DoS-via-commented-lines fix; astro toolchain otherwise pulls older transitive versions
_overridesReasons.h3: BLOCKER: force >=1.15.9 to include SSE carriage-return sanitization + path traversal fixes; upstream astro/nitro transitives lag
_overridesReasons.yaml: BLOCKER: force >=2.8.3 to include stack-overflow-on-deeply-nested-collections fix; astro transitive chain otherwise holds tree at older version
_overridesReasons.svgo: BLOCKER: pin ^4.0.2 to avoid the multiple older v2/v3 transitive versions pulled in via astro icon pipeline, and to clear GHSA-2p49-hgcm-8545 (removeScripts plugin leaves some executable scripts intact; vulnerable >=4.0.0 <4.0.2). astro@5.18.1 declares svgo ^4.0.0 and froze the lockfile at 4.0.1, so the patched 4.0.2 needs the override bumped even though it satisfies astro's own caret.
_overridesReasons.devalue: BLOCKER: force ^5.8.1 to include GHSA-77vg-94rm-hx3p (DoS via sparse array deserialization) fix; astro 5.x pulls 5.6.x by default which is in the affected range >=5.6.3, <=5.8.0
_overridesReasons.hono: BLOCKER: force >=4.12.25 to carry the >=4.12.18 fixes plus serve-static path traversal (GHSA-wwfh-h76j-fc44), CORS wildcard reflection (GHSA-88fw-hqm2-52qc), Set-Cookie merge (GHSA-j6c9-x7qj-28xf), body-limit bypass (GHSA-rv63-4mwf-qqc2), and Lambda@Edge header drop (GHSA-wgpf-jwqj-8h8p); @modelcontextprotocol/sdk transitively pulls older hono
_overridesReasons.@hono/node-server: BLOCKER: force >=1.19.13 to pair with hono >=4.12.25 override; pre-1.19 cannot start against hono 4.12.x
_overridesReasons.vite: BLOCKER: bound >=6.4.2 <8 to capture dev-server path-traversal + fs.deny fixes while staying compatible with vitest/@vitest 3.x and the astro stack; vite 8 release is a breaking major we have not planned for
_overridesReasons.postcss: BLOCKER: force >=8.5.18 to include GHSA-qx2v-qp2m-jg93 XSS-via-unescaped-style-tag and GHSA-r28c-9q8g-f849 sourceMappingURL path-traversal (arbitrary .map file disclosure, patched 8.5.18) fixes; vite/marpit transitives otherwise hold tree at 8.5.8
_overridesReasons.fast-uri: BLOCKER: force >=3.1.3 to include GHSA-q3j6-qgpj-74h6 (encoded path-separator normalization), GHSA-v39h-62p7-jpjc (encoded authority delimiter), and GHSA-4c8g-83qw-93j6 (host confusion via failed IDN canonicalization; vulnerable >=3.0.0 <3.1.3) fixes; transitive consumers (fastify-swagger, ajv-formats) otherwise hold older versions. Bounded <4 because the only consumer in this tree is ajv@8.20.0, which declares fast-uri ^3.0.1; an unbounded range would drag the untested 4.x major into the MCP SDK's schema validator.
_overridesReasons.fast-xml-builder: BLOCKER: force >=1.1.7 to include GHSA-5wm8-gmm8-39j9 attribute-quote injection fix; aws-sdk @aws-sdk/xml-builder transitively pulls older fast-xml-parser/fast-xml-builder
_overridesReasons.ip-address: BLOCKER: force ^10.1.1 to include GHSA-v2v4-37r5-5v8g (XSS in Address6 HTML-emitting methods) fix; express-rate-limit@8.3.1 pulls 10.1.0 which is in the affected <= 10.1.0 range
_overridesReasons.protobufjs: BLOCKER: force >=7.5.6 to clear the 7.x advisories (GHSA-66ff/2pr8/fx83/75px/jvwf/685m/q6x5/xq3m all affected <= 7.5.5) — npm picks 8.2.0+ for the otlp-transformer chain which also clears the 8.0.0-8.0.1 critical RCE; @opentelemetry/sdk-node is pinned in .syncpackrc.json so we cannot bump the outer tree
_overridesReasons.@grpc/proto-loader: BLOCKER: nested override pins protobufjs ^7.5.6 inside the @grpc/proto-loader chain since proto-loader@0.8.x requires the 7.x major and cannot accept 8.x; pairs with the outer protobufjs >=7.5.6 override which handles the 8.x consumers
_overridesReasons.zod: BLOCKER: force ^4.4.3 across the whole tree so @modelcontextprotocol/sdk and the cli workspace share the same physical zod copy; without the override the SDK satisfies its 'zod: ^3.25 || ^4.0' range with the older zod@3.25.x that other transitives drag in, creating two zod installs whose v4/core $ZodType interfaces TS treats as distinct nominal types (build breaks at registerTool inputSchema)
_overridesReasons.astro: BLOCKER: astro's config validator (validateConfigRefined) was written against zod v3 and calls config.image.remotePatterns.length on the parsed shape; under the root zod ^4.4.3 override it gets undefined and the build crashes with 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading length)'. Nest a zod ^3.25.76 override scoped to astro to match astro's own peer dep declaration. @astrojs/sitemap and @astrojs/rss already declare zod ^4 themselves so they stay on the root override.
_overridesReasons.js-yaml: BLOCKER: force >=4.2.0 <5.0.0 to include GHSA-h67p-54hq-rp68 (quadratic-complexity DoS via repeated merge-key aliases) fix while staying off the v5 major; @astrojs/markdown-remark and astro transitively pull js-yaml@4.1.1, and @astrojs/markdown-remark's `import yaml from "js-yaml"` default import breaks under js-yaml 5.x's ESM-only export shape (observed as a hard `astro build` SyntaxError)
_overridesReasons.gray-matter: BLOCKER: nested override pins js-yaml ^3.15.0 inside the gray-matter chain since gray-matter's frontmatter parser is written against the js-yaml v3 API and cannot accept v4; GHSA-h67p-54hq-rp68 covers two disjoint ranges (>=4.0.0 <=4.1.1 AND <3.15.0), so the v3 line also needed bumping to its final 3.15.0 patch release
_overridesReasons.linkify-it: BLOCKER: force >=5.0.1 to include GHSA-22p9-wv53-3rq4 (quadratic-complexity DoS in LinkifyIt#match) fix; markdown-it (via @marp-team/marpit) transitively pulls linkify-it@5.0.0
_overridesReasons.brace-expansion@^1.1.7: BLOCKER: clear GHSA-3jxr-9vmj-r5cp (DoS via exponential-time expansion of consecutive non-expanding {} groups; vulnerable <1.1.16 || >=3.0.0 <5.0.7) for the six eslint/minimatch@3 edges that request ^1.1.7. Pin to 1.1.18 (the patched 1.x, raised from 1.1.16 for GHSA-rgw5-rvv9-x895: the CVE-2026-14257 maxLength mitigation was incomplete, intermediate arrays stayed unbounded) rather than blanket-bumping to v5: brace-expansion v5 became ESM-only and its CommonJS build changed from `module.exports = expand` to a NAMED export `{ expand, EXPANSION_MAX }`, so minimatch@3's `var expand = require('brace-expansion'); expand(pattern)` throws 'expand is not a function' and eslint crashes. 1.1.16 keeps the callable default export and is out of the vulnerable range.
_overridesReasons.brace-expansion@^5.0.5: BLOCKER: clear GHSA-3jxr-9vmj-r5cp and GHSA-mh99-v99m-4gvg (unbounded expansion LENGTH — expand() caps the result count but not each result's size, so chained brace groups OOM the process; vulnerable <=5.0.7, patched 5.0.8) plus GHSA-rgw5-rvv9-x895 (the 5.0.8 maxLength mitigation was incomplete, intermediate arrays stayed unbounded; completed in 5.0.9) for the single top-level minimatch@10 edge that requests ^5.0.5. This consumer expects the v5 named-export API, so it stays on the v5 line — kept separate from the ^1.1.7 override above so neither consumer is forced across brace-expansion's v4->v5 export-shape break.
